how_to_apply: Visit the official HPRCA website at hprca.hp.gov.in.
Open the One Time Registration (OTR) section.
Complete OTR if you have not already registered.
Log in using the registered credentials.
Complete or update your profile, including personal information, educational qualifications and relevant category details.
Open the available recruitment advertisements and select Advertisement No. 14/2026.
Choose the teaching post and post code for which you meet the prescribed eligibility.
Click Apply for the selected post.
Verify the information automatically populated from your OTR profile.
Complete any remaining post-specific details required by the application form.
Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
Review the completed application carefully before submission.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 800 through the available online payment method.
Submit the Online Recruitment Application by 5 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Download or print the submitted application for future reference.
Important: HPRCA permits only one application per post from an applicant. Multiple applications for the same post may be rejected. No offline application will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The HPRCA Teacher Vacancy 2026 notification announces 2,423 teaching posts across 15 subjects . Mathematics has the highest number of vacancies, with 281 posts. The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease according to departmental requirements. Candidates should select the correct post code when completing the application form. Reservation Note: Reservation benefits are governed by Himachal Pradesh Government rules. Candidates belonging to reserved categories of other states will be considered under the General (Unreserved) category, according to the notification.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog has released for 2,423 teaching vacancies in Government CBSE-affiliated schools. The official 23-page notification contains the subject-wise and category-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limits, honorarium, temporary engagement terms, application fee, selection process, examination syllabus and online application instructions. Official Notification Source: HPRCA Recruitment Notifications

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the post-specific educational qualifications by 5 December 2026 . Most subjects require a relevant Master's degree, B.Ed. and Teacher Eligibility Test (TET), while some specialized teaching posts have alternative qualification pathways. English and Mathematics Teacher candidates must meet the specific graduation, postgraduate and teacher-training requirements prescribed in the notification. The applicable relaxation in minimum marks for eligible Himachal Pradesh reserved categories must be checked against the detailed qualification conditions. The Computer Teacher post provides multiple educational qualification pathways, including: B.E. or B.Tech. in Computer Science or Information Technology with the prescribed marks. B.E. or B.Tech. in any stream with a recognized postgraduate diploma in Computer Science, Technology or Applications. M.Sc. Computer Science or MCA with the prescribed marks. Postgraduate degree in Mathematics or Physics with a postgraduate diploma in Computer Science or Computer Applications. DOEACC 'B' or 'C' Level qualification from the recognized authority, meeting the notified marks requirements. Candidates must also meet the prescribed proficiency requirement for teaching in Hindi and English. The Physical Education Teacher post accepts specified professional qualifications recognized under the relevant NCTE regulations, including the applicable B.P.Ed., integrated Physical Education degree and other notified training routes. Applicants should carefully compare their qualification, course duration and minimum marks with the detailed notification. Applicants may qualify through a recognized Master's degree in Fine Arts or Visual Arts, including Painting and Sculpture, with the prescribed minimum marks. The notification provides up to 5% relaxation in minimum educational marks for eligible SC, ST, OBC and PwD candidates of Himachal Pradesh, where specified against the qualification. Applicants should not assume that the same minimum marks or relaxation applies identically to every educational route.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the advertised Teacher posts is 18 to 45 years as on 1 January 2026 . Eligible reserved category candidates may receive upper-age relaxation according to the provisions applicable to their category. Supporting certificates must be valid under the notification's conditions.

rows.details: As per Applicable Himachal Pradesh Government Rules

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 30,000 per month for 10 months in an academic year , under the notified teacher engagement scheme. Salary Clarification: The honorarium is not a regular government teacher pay scale. The notified amount is payable for 10 months during an academic year and should not be represented as a guaranteed 12-month salary. No. The advertised appointments are temporary engagements under the Government's teacher engagement scheme for a period of five years. Selected teachers will not be treated as regular Government employees and will have no right to regularisation against sanctioned vacancies. The engagement conditions will be governed by the applicable scheme notified by the Himachal Pradesh Department of School Education.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 800 for all categories , consisting of an examination fee of Rs. 100 and a processing fee of Rs. 700. Payment Mode: Online through Credit Card, Debit Card or Net Banking using the official payment gateway. The examination and processing fees are non-refundable. Candidates must pay the prescribed correction fee if they use the application correction facility.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a Computer Based Test (CBT) or Written Screening Test carrying 120 marks , followed by verification of the prescribed eligibility documents. Online Application: Candidates submit their Online Recruitment Application through HPRCA. CBT / Written Screening Test: Eligible applicants appear in the examination conducted by the Aayog. Merit Preparation: Candidates are ranked according to examination performance and applicable selection rules. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates produce original certificates and self-attested photocopies. Final Selection: HPRCA prepares the selection recommendations according to vacancies, eligibility and reservation requirements. The notification does not prescribe a separate interview as a general selection stage for these posts.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The HPRCA Teacher screening examination will contain 120 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying one mark each . The examination duration is 90 minutes. The examination will assess subject knowledge up to the level of the prescribed qualification and general knowledge topics. Subject-specific knowledge relevant to the selected teaching post. General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh. Current Affairs. Everyday Science. Logical Reasoning. Social Science. General English at Matriculation level. General Hindi at Matriculation level. The detailed subject-wise syllabus is available in the Downloads section of the official HPRCA website. Candidates should follow the syllabus corresponding to their specific post.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Domicile and Reservation Conditions
content_sections.text: The notification contains important eligibility and reservation conditions for candidates from Himachal Pradesh and other states. Applicants must generally have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from an institution situated within Himachal Pradesh. This condition does not apply to bona fide Himachali candidates, as provided in the notification. State reservation benefits are available to eligible bona fide Himachal Pradesh residents who satisfy the applicable caste, category and certificate requirements. Reserved category candidates belonging to other states will be treated as General (Unreserved) candidates for this recruitment. OBC-NCL, EWS, BPL, Ward of Freedom Fighter and other relevant category certificates must meet the notification's validity requirements. Certain certificates must remain valid both on the application closing date and at document verification.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for the 2,423 Teacher vacancies through the official HPRCA online recruitment website from 10 November 2026 at 10:00 AM to 5 December 2026 at 11:59 PM . Apply Online: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment Official Portal 14/2026. Application Status: Opens on 10 November 2026. Last Date: 5 December 2026. One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before filling out the Online Recruitment Application. Candidates applying for different eligible teaching posts must follow the separate post-wise application requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: HPRCA permits only one application per post from an applicant. Multiple applications for the same post may be rejected. No offline application will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the required certificates supporting educational qualifications, age, category, professional training and other claimed eligibility conditions. Matriculation certificate for age verification. 10+2 qualification certificate, where applicable. Graduation certificate and marksheets. Relevant postgraduate qualification certificate and marksheets. B.Ed. or other prescribed professional training qualification. Teacher Eligibility Test certificate, where required. Relevant subject-specific professional certificates. Valid SC/ST/OBC/EWS/BPL or other category certificate, if applicable. Bonafide Himachali certificate, where applicable. Ward of Freedom Fighter or other supporting certificate, if applicable. Valid identity and other documents required by HPRCA. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. The photograph must be a recent passport-size image, not older than one month, as specified in the notification. Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents and self-attested photocopies at the time of document verification.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: HPRCA will provide a four-day application correction window after the closing of the Online Recruitment Application period. Candidates should not depend on the correction facility to fix all application errors. Certain category claims and other details may be subject to restrictions after submission.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: HPRCA will release the admit cards for the CBT or Written Screening Test through its official website after announcing the examination schedule. Provisionally admitted candidates will be able to download their admit cards using the login or authentication procedure specified by the Aayog. Admit cards will not be sent by post. Official Admit Card Website: hprca.hp.gov.in

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HPRCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 5 December 2026. Applications opened on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HPRCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2423 vacancies: 187 English Teacher, 281 Mathematics Teacher, 187 Teacher (Hindi), 156 Teacher (Political Science), 156 Teacher (History), 156 Teacher (Economics) and 9 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HPRCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Fixed honorarium/remuneration of Rs. 30,000 per month payable for 10 months in an academic year for English Teacher, Fixed honorarium/remuneration of Rs. 30,000 per month payable for 10 months in an academic year for Mathematics Teacher, Fixed honorarium/remuneration of Rs. 30,000 per month payable for 10 months in an academic year for Teacher (Hindi), Fixed honorarium/remuneration of Rs. 30,000 per month payable for 10 months in an academic year for Teacher (Political Science), Fixed honorarium/remuneration of Rs. 30,000 per month payable for 10 months in an academic year for Teacher (History).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post-wise. English and Mathematics Teacher: M.A/M.Sc. in the subject with 50% marks at Graduation level, B.Ed with the subject as compulsory, and TET. Hindi, Political Science, History, Economics: Master's Degree in the subject concerned (50% aggregate), B.Ed with 50% marks, and TET. Other posts: see official notification. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA. Teacher (Hindi), (Political Science), (History), (Economics): proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) passed, as required in the qualification of each post.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates of States other than Himachal Pradesh are treated as General (UR) without reservation or fee concession.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written screening test (Computer Based Test or OMR based test). Document verification. Written screening test by CBT; OMR based test may be preferred where the number of candidates is limited. Candidates shortlisted for document verification to allow recommendation and the waiting panel.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely scheme based, temporary engagement for a period of Five (05) Years, not against any sanctioned posts. No right of regularization against any vacant sanctioned posts of Education Department.
